measurement_basis.note: The trace predates the current conv-remap, direct-leaf-commit, and GDN dead-I/O patches; FA2 geometry is still the pinned 64x64 four-warp kernel.

candidate.scope: BF16 B1, params.d=d_rounded=256, params.h=24, params.h_k=4, noncausal, full-window, no ALiBi, no appended KV, paged KV with 1024-row pages, tree_bias=32x32 at offsets 0/0, seqlen_q=32, num_splits=1
candidate.numerical_mechanism: Each CTA owns complete query rows and traverses the full ordered K-block loop. There is no executed KV split, output combine, or changed num_splits value. Warp-local row and lane coordinates match the stock tile for all 32 real rows. AllowSplit=false discards both the combine block and the Split=true main-kernel specialization for one-warp traits; stock traits retain their prior split switch. Static assertions fix 32 threads, eight KV-copy threads per row, and 16 rows per thread. The private default-off selector throws unless the exact production 1024-row paged-KV geometry engages.
candidate.performance_risk: Each head rereads K/V in two query CTAs. The doubled KV traffic can offset the occupancy and masked-row gains at long contexts.
